curriculumAlignmentSummary: Unit 7 covers digital literacy, information collection sources (books, web sources, surveys, Google forms), components of digital literacy (search literacy, technical skills, communication, collaboration, content creation, ethics), key ideas extraction, poster and billboard designing, and social media platforms (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Podcast, X/Twitter). The past papers map to digital literacy definitions, digital divide, social media communication tools, cybersecurity/ethics concepts, and digital tools for business research.
